episodes.synopsis: When Mikan's best friend Hotaru transfers to the mysterious Alice Academy a worried Mikan follows her.
episodes.title: Our School Will Be Gone

episodes.synopsis: Mikan is accepted into Alice Academy and can finally see Hotaru again.
episodes.title: Welcome to Gakuen Alice

episodes.synopsis: Mikan learns that everyone in Alice Academy has an Alice and that people with Alices are valued by the world.
episodes.title: I Won't Let Alice Get to Me

episodes.synopsis: In the North Forest Mikan, Hotaru, and Iincho get trapped by a violent Teddy Bear, and a giant chick.
episodes.title: This Is My Alice

episodes.synopsis: Mikan has finally been accepted by her classmates after discovering that she has the nullification Alice.
episodes.title: The Star-Class Is Tough

episodes.synopsis: Mikan begins to feel that her Alice is useless compared to her classmates cool Alices.
episodes.title: I'm with the Good-for-Nothing Types

episodes.synopsis: Natsume and his gang keep ditching class. Mikan makes a bet with Natsume that if she wins in a dodgeball game he and his friends will stop skipping class.
episodes.title: I Won't Lose the Alice Dodgeball

episodes.synopsis: Whenever Mikan writes a letter to her grandfather, she gives it to Narumi who she believes is sending them to her grandfather.
episodes.title: I Want to See Grandpa

episodes.synopsis: Hotaru is up for an honor student prize against an older student. Whoever wins in a robot fighting match will get the prize.
episodes.title: I Love You, Hotaru

episodes.synopsis: All of the students get an allowance and one day they decide to go to the campus's Central Town, the mall for Alice Academy students.
episodes.title: How Exciting, Central Town

episodes.synopsis: Mikan's dorm catches on fire and all of the students use there Alices to help put it out. Including Mikan who tries to save a little kid's prized possession.
episodes.title: Alice, I'm in Special Training

episodes.synopsis: The school festival has begun! It will last for two weeks ending with a dance. The four groups will each participate and the one that has the best performance will win an award.
episodes.title: The School Festival Is Here

episodes.synopsis: The festival continues. Reo, a graduate of the school and now famous singer, even comes to give a concert. However the big star has other plans besides a concert. His real mission is to kidnap Natsume!
episodes.title: Go After the Superstar

episodes.synopsis: Mikan and Sumire who had witnessed Reo kidnapping Natsume escape from the school to rescue him.
episodes.title: Let's Bring Natsume Back

episodes.synopsis: Mikan manages to get in contact with the school through the communication device Hotaru gave her. As Natsume burns through the ropes tying him Narumi gives the three instructions.
episodes.title: Let's Go Back to the Academy

episodes.synopsis: The Special type class has set up their RPG maze game for the festival and are ready for costumers!
episodes.title: Imagine the Maze, the Magic Lamp

episodes.synopsis: Mikan joins Natsume and Ruka for the rest of the festival as Natsume's slave.
episodes.title: Hotaru's Secret

episodes.synopsis: Ruka explains to Mikan why Natsume acts the way he does. The three end up at the hunted house attraction.
episodes.title: Just the Two of Us, in the Dark

episodes.synopsis: Ruka is starring in the festival's play along with a girl named Yuri.
episodes.title: Raise the Curtain, Snow White Sleeping Beauty

episodes.synopsis: The Special Ability class receives an award for their RPG. At the award ceremony Mikan sees the principles for the first time and Narumi decides to give Mikan her grandpas letters.
episodes.title: Who Will Have the Last Dance?

episodes.synopsis: Its exam time at Alice Academy, and those who do well are rewarded. The person who gets the top marks will be rewarded with a trip back to their family and a Central Town shopping ticket.
episodes.title: Aim for the Honor Student Award

episodes.synopsis: Kaname who has the Alice of putting souls into dolls visits the school from the hospital for one week. He created Mr. Bear when he was little and during his stay at school he creates more dolls for his classmates. However using his Alice comes at a price.
episodes.title: Mr. Bear and the Prince

episodes.synopsis: The circus has come to Alice Academy for Academy Day. Mikan is moved by the circus and starts preaching to everybody that they should work hard without using their Alice.
episodes.title: The Circus Is Here

episodes.synopsis: The students rebel when Natsume is forced to go on another mission. Narumi, threatened by Persona, pretends to offer his help to the students but tricks them instead.
episodes.title: Mr. Narumi's Lie

episodes.synopsis: Reo sends his own crew to help the students rebel. Upon finding out that Reo was behind everything the students change sides and work together with the teachers to bring Reo down.
episodes.title: Take Back the Academy

episodes.synopsis: Mikan fails her finals and has to take makeups. While stressing about what will happen to her if she fails the makeups, Mikan finds out that Hotaru is transferring after graduation.
episodes.title: Friendship Is Endless
